name: Industrial High Carbon Steel Flat Bastard Hand File with Handle (10-Inch / 250mm)
shortDescription: Heavy-duty 250mm flat bastard engineer's hand file forged from T12 alloy tool steel (62-64 HRC) with double-cut teeth for aggressive material removal and deburring.
overview: The Industrial 10-Inch (250mm) Flat Bastard Hand File is the essential metalworking tool for rapid material removal, surface leveling, and deburring on steel weldments, iron castings, and non-ferrous metals. Precision-forged from high-carbon T12 alloy tool steel and heat-treated to an extreme surface hardness of 62-64 HRC, it features double-cut cross-hatch teeth on both flat faces and single-cut teeth on both edges. The teeth bite aggressively without clogging, allowing fitters to true torch-cut plate edges, dress weld crowns, and establish accurate flat reference planes.
keyFeatures: Precision cut from premium high-carbon T12 alloy tool steel for maximum wear resistance
Induction hardened to 62 – 64 HRC ensuring long-lasting tooth sharpness on hard steels
Double-cut pattern on both flat faces provides rapid, aggressive stock removal
Single-cut teeth on both narrow edges allow filing right into 90° interior corners
Slight taper in width towards point facilitates entry into narrow slots and keyways
Fitted with an ergonomic dual-material soft-grip handle with non-slip finger contours
Manufactured in strict conformance with IS 1931 and DIN 7261 standards

specifications.Profile / Cross-Section: Rectangular Flat (Parallel with slightly tapered point)
specifications.Tooth Pattern: Double-Cut on Faces / Single-Cut on Edges
specifications.Handle: Ergonomic Molded Thermoplastic Rubber (TPR) Handle Included

applications: Rapid stock removal on torch-cut steel plates and structural gusset edges
Deburring sheared sheet metal, punched holes, and drilled structural beams
Dressing weld beads, spatter, and slag before non-destructive testing (NDT)
Keyway filing, machine tool bed fitting, and general maintenance fabrication
